name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice in force; gas buffer 99 mcm/d
summary: Cold spell from 15 Nov raises demand; no Electricity Margin or Gas Margins Notice found in force on 17 Nov
state: National Gas's winter outlook of 23 Oct expects sufficient supply, with a 99 mcm/d buffer over a 493 mcm/d peak (Pipeline & Gas Journal). NESO issued an Electricity Margin Notice on 28 Sep for a low-wind evening peak, flagging a 1.4 GW shortfall (OilPrice). Cold weather and frost hit northern Britain from 15 Nov (ITV News), but searches on 17 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Margin notices are routine signals to generators, not warnings of power cuts. Still, cold, windless evenings are when the system is tightest; NESO and National Gas publish any notices.
rubric_hit: No NESO Electricity Margin Notice or National Gas Margins Notice in force (Normal)

sources.title: UK gas grid ready for winter with 99 mcm/d supply buffer as peak demand rises, National Gas says
UK Grid Operator Warns of Tight Power Margins

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
